score_era_policy: Numerical scores from episodes 1-7 are legacy benchmark_contract_version 1; v2 scores use saved_p_backward_only and are not directly comparable.
avoid_patterns: Avoid correctness failures: verify RMSNorm formula y=(x/rms(x))*weight
Avoid regressions: ensure kernel is faster than incumbent across ALL shapes
Avoid compilation errors: ensure candidate.cu is valid standalone CUDA C++
recommendations: Use float4 vectorized loads for coalesced memory access on V100
Use warp-shuffle or shared-memory reduction for normalization statistics
Use one 256-thread block per row for row-wise normalization
Use shared-memory reduction for mean/variance or mean-of-squares
Guard all thread accesses with batch/row bounds checking
Test ALL evaluation shapes before claiming correctness
apply_when: Standalone CUDA kernel with no PyTorch dependency
avoid_when: Missing batch/row bounds checking in kernel
Regressions vs current incumbent on ANY shape
